verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for an AI app-building platform, but the evidence pack never documents acting on many items at once, such as multi-project or multi-file batch actions. Broad statements about the AI controlling the filesystem and environment, Code view editing, and reusable prompts or skills are adjacent features, not a documented bulk-operations capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
